summary: Patch looks good, but requires further testing and review to ensure correctness and maintainability.

issues.description: Automated tests already pass, but the contributor has not run the full suite of tests on this change.
The fix uses the current_app parameter, which is a good approach, but it's not immediately clear why this is necessary without reading the issue description.
The patch is minimal and follows the project's coding style, but it's always a good idea to include a docstring or comment explaining the change and its reasoning.
